subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw core docs accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide under docs/install while excluding turnkey vendor hardware references?
rationale: The docs shape matches existing Raspberry Pi precedent, but the linked issue explicitly asks for maintainer policy on first-party hardware docs and vendor/appliance references.

options.title: Accept after docs repair
options.body: Allow the vendor-neutral Jetson guide once the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and appliance/vendor promotion remains out of core docs.

options.title: Move to ecosystem docs
options.body: Decline first-party placement and ask for Jetson/appliance-specific guidance to live in vendor docs, ClawHub, or another ecosystem surface.

options.title: Defer hardware policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a broader policy for Jetson, Raspberry Pi, mini PC, and appliance documentation.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs repair
recommendation.body: Allow the vendor-neutral Jetson guide once the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and appliance/vendor promotion remains out of core docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about first-party docs scope and VISION/ClawHub policy, where the strongest current history signal points to steipete.
